create_oracle_power_on_in_place_skill: create an OraclePowerOnInPlaceSkill to power on a nearby object within maximum distance
create_oracle_power_off_in_place_skill: create an OraclePowerOffInPlaceSkill to power off a nearby object within maximum distance
create_oracle_power_on_skill: create an OraclePowerOnSkill compound skill that navigates to an object then powers it on
create_oracle_power_off_skill: create an OraclePowerOffSkill compound skill that navigates to an object then powers it off
